hero.description: VibeGraph turns a Java codebase into an explorable map of structure, dependencies and execution flows. Use CLI watch mode to send later file changes, and query the resulting project graph before editing code.

telemetry.placeholder: Click any graph node to simulate real-time impact analysis

challenge.title: The messy middle of codebase comprehension

overload.title: Cognitive Overload
overload.body: Searching through raw files and text is slow, confusing, and fails to reveal actual execution context.

refactor.title: Fear of Refactoring
refactor.body: Editing a method or route could break multiple upstream dependencies or tests without warning.

agent.title: AI Agent Blindspots
agent.body: Coding agents lack full call-graph awareness, which leads to broken edits and regression issues.

maps.title: Interactive Code Maps
maps.body: We render your Java codebase as an explorable network, showing classes, methods, and routes visually.

impact.title: Instant Blast-Radius Reports
impact.body: Query graph relationships, trace available execution flows, and inspect impact data before editing code.

mcp.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
mcp.body: Expose project graph data to MCP clients, so coding agents can query context and impact information.

features.title: Everything you need to read a codebase fast
features.description: Built for the messy middle of real projects, where the architecture lives in everyone's head and nowhere else.

graph.title: Code as a living graph
graph.body: Classes, methods, fields and routes rendered as an explorable force-directed graph. Pan, zoom and focus to follow any call chain.

impact.title: Blast-radius analysis
impact.body: Pick a node and inspect the callers, related flows and risk information available in the analyzed project graph.

realtime.title: Updates as you vibe
realtime.body: Use CLI watch mode to detect supported file changes and send incremental updates to the selected project.

diagrams.title: Architecture diagrams
diagrams.body: Reverse-engineered UML use-case diagrams generated straight from the source: design-vs-code verification, not hand-drawn fiction.

import.title: CLI, archive or GitHub
import.body: Create a CLI workspace, upload a supported archive, or provide a public GitHub URL for backend analysis.

how.title: From repo to insight in three steps

import.title: Import your project
import.body: Local folder, archive, or a public GitHub repo. VibeGraph parses the source and builds the index.

explore.title: Explore the graph
explore.body: Navigate structure visually, search any symbol, and trace execution flows across the whole codebase.

analyze.title: Analyze impact
analyze.body: Before refactoring, run blast-radius analysis to inspect the relationships recorded for the selected symbol.

mock.pasteGithub: Or paste a GitHub repository endpoint
mock.downstreamAffected: Affected callers are calculated from project graph data
mock.upstreamRiskHigh: Risk is calculated from the selected graph node

guide.title: Install the CLI and connect your project
guide.description: The current production flow for browser login, project upload and MCP integration.

step1.title: Step 1: Install and sign in
step1.body: Configure the production URL, then run browser login. After authentication, select a project API key for CLI and MCP operations.
step1.envTail: before installing: the repository package name is final, but the public npm package must exist before the global install command can succeed.

step2.title: Step 2: Create or upload a project
step2.bodyTail: and choose a supported project source:
step2.localBody: create the project from the CLI, push its Java files, and optionally keep watch mode running for later changes.
step2.githubBody: provide a public HTTPS repository URL for backend import and analysis.
step2.note: The backend parses the source, stores the call graph in Neo4j, and the Vue client renders it with Sigma.js. Search any symbol, double-click a node to focus, or select one to see its blast radius.

step3.title: Step 3: Connect your AI agent over MCP
step3.bodyLead: VibeGraph runs a Model Context Protocol server over
step3.bodyTail: , so agents like Claude, Cursor and Kiro can query the graph and run impact analysis. Point your agent at the endpoint:
step3.noteLead: The current backend registers 18 MCP tools covering impact analysis, class and method context, references, tests, endpoint traces, source retrieval, verification and planning. Client configuration keys can differ; the manual production example uses

engine.title: How VibeGraph reads your code
engine.description: A Java AST-and-graph engine backed by Neo4j. VibeGraph serves analyzed project data to the web UI and authenticated MCP clients.
engine.bodyLead: VibeGraph parses your Java source into abstract syntax trees, resolves call and usage relationships, and stores the whole graph in
engine.bodyTail: . In the hosted production service, projects uploaded through CLI, archive or GitHub are processed by the VibeGraph backend.

private.title: Project-scoped access
private.body: CLI and MCP operations use the selected project key, while the backend checks key ownership and request authorization.

incremental.title: Incremental
incremental.body: CLI watch mode detects supported changes and sends incremental project updates to the backend.

mcp.title: MCP-native
mcp.body: the analyzed graph is exposed through a Spring AI MCP server with project-key authentication.

agents.title: Code intelligence, one MCP call away
agents.description: VibeGraph exposes its graph through the Model Context Protocol, so your AI coding agent can query structure, trace flows and run impact analysis right inside your editor.

cta.title: Ready to map your codebase?
cta.description: Log in, open the dashboard and add a Java project using one of the supported import paths.

footer.note: Source-code intelligence for the vibe-coding era.
